lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਬਿੰਨਿ ਦੁਗਣ ਜੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਸੁਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਾਨਵ ਹਿਲਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik bi(n)n dugan j tau rahai jaa suma(n)tr maanav hilahi ||
lines.translation: Realizing the One Lord, love of duality ceases, and one comes to accept the Sublime Mantra of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਲਪਾ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਇਤੜੇ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jaalapaa padaarath itaRe gur amaradaas dithai milahi ||5||14||
lines.translation: So speaks Jaalap: countless treasures are obtained, by the sight of Guru Amar Daas. ||5||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach naam karataar s driR naanak sa(n)grahiau ||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak gathered up the True Name of the Creator Lord, and implanted it within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਲਹਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਤਾਸੁ ਚਰਣਹ ਲਿਵ ਰਹਿਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa te a(n)gad lahanaa pragat taas charanah liv rahiau ||
lines.translation: Through Him, Lehnaa became manifest in the form of Guru Angad, who remained lovingly attuned to His Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਕੁਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਆਸਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਵਣ ਵਖਾਣਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit kul gur amaradaas aasaa nivaas taas gun kavan vakhaanau ||
lines.translation: Guru Amar Daas of that dynasty is the home of hope. How can I express His Glorious Virtues?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਅਲਖ ਅਗੰਮ ਤਿਨਹ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo gun alakh aga(n)m tinah gun a(n)t na jaanau ||
lines.translation: His Virtues are unknowable and unfathomable. I do not know the limits of His Virtues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥਉ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਨਿਰਮਯੌ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: bohithau bidhaatai niramayau sabh sa(n)gat kul udharan ||
lines.translation: The Creator, the Architect of Destiny, has made Him a boat to carry all His generations across, along with the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕੀਰਤੁ ਕਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤੁਅ ਪਾ ਸਰਣ ॥੧॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur amaradaas keerat kahai traahi traahi tu paa saran ||1||15||
lines.translation: So speaks Keerat: O Guru Amar Daas, please protect me and save me; I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵਰਿਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap naraain kalaa dhaar jag mahi paravariyau ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself wielded His Power and entered the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਕਰਿਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nira(n)kaar aakaar jot jag ma(n)dal kariyau ||
lines.translation: The Formless Lord took form, and with His Light He illuminated the realms of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕਹ ਤਹ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਪਕਿ ਦੀਪਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah kah tah bharapoor sabad deepak deepaayau ||
lines.translation: He is All-pervading everywhere; the Lamp of the Shabad, the Word, has been lit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਖਹ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਮਿਲਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih sikhah sa(n)grahio tat har charan milaayau ||
lines.translation: Whoever gathers in the essence of the teachings shall be absorbed in the Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲਿ ਨਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਵਤਰੵਿਉ ਅੰਗਦ ਲਹਣੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੁਅ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kul ni(n)mal avataryiu a(n)gad lahane sa(n)g hu ||
lines.translation: Lehnaa, who became Guru Angad, and Guru Amar Daas, have been reincarnated into the pure house of Guru Nanak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਪਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਅ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur amaradaas taaran taran janam janam paa saran tu ||2||16||
lines.translation: Guru Amar Daas is our Saving Grace, who carries us across; in lifetime after lifetime, I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||2||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sat sa(n)tokh pikh darasan gur sikhah ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the Gursikh is blessed with chanting and deep meditation, truth and contentment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਮ ਪੁਰ ਕੀ ਲਿਖਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran parahi te ubarahi chhod jam pur kee likhah ||
lines.translation: Whoever seeks His Sanctuary is saved; his account is cleared in the City of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਚਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat bhaai bharapoor ridai ucharai karataarai ||
lines.translation: His heart is totally filled with loving devotion; he chants to the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਪਲਕ ਡੁਬੰਤੵਹ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur gauhar dareeaau palak duba(n)tyh taarai ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the river of pearls; in an instant, he carries the drowning ones across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲਿ ਨਿੰਮਲੁ ਅਵਤਰੵਿਉ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਤਾਰੈ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kul ni(n)mal avataryiu gun karataarai ucharai ||
lines.translation: He was reincarnated into the House of Guru Nanak; He chants the Glorious Praises of the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਅਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੩॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur amaradaas jinh seviau tinh dukh daridr parahar parai ||3||17||
lines.translation: Those who serve Guru Amar Daas - their pains and poverty are taken away, far away. ||3||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਹਉ ਪਰੁ ਕਹਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chit chitavau aradaas kahau par kahi bh na sakau ||
lines.translation: I consciously pray within my consciousness, but I cannot express it in words.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਚਿੰਤ ਤੁਝੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਉ ਤਕਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab chi(n)t tujh paas saadhasa(n)gat hau takau ||
lines.translation: I place all my worries and anxieties before You; I look to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, for help.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਤਉ ਕਰਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: terai hukam pavai neesaan tau karau saahib kee sevaa ||
lines.translation: By the Hukam of Your Command, I am blessed with Your Insignia; I serve my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab gur dekhai subh disat naam karataa mukh mevaa ||
lines.translation: When You, O Guru, gaze at me with Your Glance of Grace, the fruit of the Naam, the Name of the Creator, is placed within my mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਲਖ ਕਾਰਣ ਪੁਰਖ ਜੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਹਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam alakh kaaran purakh jo phuramaavahi so kahau ||
lines.translation: The Unfathomable and Unseen Primal Lord God, the Cause of causes - as He orders, so do I speak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਜਿਵ ਤੂ ਰਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਰਹਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur amaradaas kaaran karan jiv too rakhahi tiv rahau ||4||18||
lines.translation: O Guru Amar Daas, Doer of deeds, Cause of causes, as You keep me, I remain; as You protect me, I survive. ||4||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਿਖੇ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhikhe ke ||
lines.translation: Of Bhikhaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan ar dhiaan tat siu tat milaavai ||
lines.translation: In deep meditation, and the spiritual wisdom of the Guru, one's essence merges with the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sach jaaneeai ik chitahi liv laavai ||
lines.translation: In truth, the True Lord is recognized and realized, when one is lovingly attuned to Him, with one-pointed consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਵਸਿ ਕਰੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਉਡੰਤ ਨ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh vas karai pavan uda(n)t na dhaavai ||
lines.translation: Lust and anger are brought under control, when the breath does not fly around, wandering restlessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਵਸੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nira(n)kaar kai vasai des hukam bujh beechaar paavai ||
lines.translation: Dwelling in the land of the Formless Lord, realizing the Hukam of His Command, His contemplative wisdom is attained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal maahi roop karataa purakh so jaanai jin kichh keeau ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Guru is the Form of the Creator, the Primal Lord God; he alone knows, who has tried it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੵਿਉ ਸੋਇ ਭਿਖਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਹਜ ਰੰਗਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਅਉ ॥੧॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: gur milyiu soi bhikhaa kahai sahaj ra(n)g darasan deeau ||1||19||
lines.translation: So speaks Bhikhaa: I have met the Guru. With love and intuitive affection, He has bestowed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹਿਓ ਸੰਤ ਹਉ ਟੋਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਡਿਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rahio sa(n)t hau tol saadh bahutere dithe ||
lines.translation: I have been searching for the Saints; I have seen so many Holy and spiritual people.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਤਪਸੀਅਹ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਏ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮਿਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)niaasee tapaseeah mukhahu e pa(n)dit mithe ||
lines.translation: The hermits, Sannyaasees, ascetics, penitents, fanatics and Pandits all speak sweetly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੁ ਏਕੁ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਕਿਨੈ ਨਹੁ ਪਰਚਉ ਲਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: baras ek hau phirio kinai nahu parachau laayau ||
lines.translation: I wandered around lost for a year, but no one touched my soul.
